# 石墨烯理想模型与 Wannier 能带输入: # Graphene in the ideal model and in a Wannier band input
MagneticTB tight binding HR export Wilso: MagneticTB tight binding HR export Wilson Chern topology surface spectrum Wannier90 Graphene_hr.dat wt.in-bands graphene
石墨烯的 K 点：理想简并与文件能带 · 材料分析: Graphene at K · ideal degeneracy and bands from file · Materials analysis
先在 [MagneticTB 工作台](../#magnetictb) 选择理想: Run the ideal graphene model in the [MagneticTB workbench](../#magnetictb). The sublattices are equivalent, and the phases of the three nearest-neighbor hoppings sum to $1+\omega+\omega^2=0$ at K, with $\omega=\exp(2\pi i/3)$. Predict the band separation at K before checking the plot. The energy scale of this ideal model is its selected hopping.
## 用配套文件计算原始路径: ## Calculate the original path using the paired files
回到工作台的 WannierTools 算例。读取并核对两份源文件后，表单会使用: Return to the WannierTools example. Verify the two files to fill the form with the real-space Hamiltonian from `Graphene_hr.dat` and the lattice and path from `wt.in-bands`. You can also download both files upstream and verify them in the browser. Review the input and run the calculation to see the M–K–Γ–M path and the two energies at K. The example uses the printed $k=(0.33333333,0.33333333,0)$ in the fractional reciprocal coordinates of the supplied lattice.
原文件含 2 个轨道、315 个平移块。构造 Bloch 矩阵时，把每个实空间块: The source has two orbitals and 315 translation blocks. To form the Bloch matrix, divide each real-space block by its weight $d_R$, multiply by $\exp(2\pi i k\cdot R)$ and sum. The supplied path is sampled at 304 points. Energies are in eV.

把表单中 K 顶点的前两个坐标都改为 `0.3333333333333333`，: Set the first two coordinates of the K vertex to `0.3333333333333333`, the double-precision value of $1/3$. Run again and check the separation in the band CSV. It remains about 2.946 meV. Shifting both energies by the same reference leaves their separation unchanged. The weighted real-space matrices satisfy $H(-R)=H(R)^\dagger$. An independent reconstruction gives a maximum Bloch Hermiticity residual along the path of about $3.03\times10^{-14}$ eV. Hermiticity gives real eigenvalues. Degeneracy at K depends on the symmetries and assumptions of the model. This numerical separation describes the supplied file at a single point on its path.
